candidates.requirement: Enable built-in PRIORITY_UPDATE reception and advertise SETTINGS_NO_RFC7540_PRIORITIES=1 so the server receive operation can process a valid PRIORITY_UPDATE frame.
candidates.target_route: LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput creates a server session, sends its SETTINGS, then passes the complete fuzz buffer to nghttp2_session_mem_recv. A client preface, initial SETTINGS, and short PRIORITY_UPDATE frame reach the new frame-type case.
candidates.failure_condition: The constructor passes no option, leaving builtin_recv_ext_types zero. The target's only submitted setting is MAX_CONCURRENT_STREAMS, so pending_no_rfc7540_priorities becomes zero. The new handler is therefore bypassed for every input.
candidates.alternative_paths: The target creates no option, installs no extension unpack callback, makes no later SETTINGS submission, and calls receive only once. Peer SETTINGS cannot set the local pending value.

candidates.requirement: Submit SETTINGS_NO_RFC7540_PRIORITIES=1 so incoming request streams can carry the flag required by the changed Priority-header application guard.
candidates.target_route: A valid client preface, initial SETTINGS, and request HEADERS on stream 1 reach the server's request-header completion path.
candidates.failure_condition: The target submits only MAX_CONCURRENT_STREAMS. Its pending no-RFC7540-priorities value becomes zero, so incoming streams lack NGHTTP2_STREAM_FLAG_NO_RFC7540_PRIORITIES and the changed priority-application condition cannot hold.
candidates.alternative_paths: Peer SETTINGS changes remote settings, not the local pending setting. The target makes no further local SETTINGS call and cannot modify the internal stream flag through input bytes.
